Hi Emma,

Following up on the earlier note about my London trip: I need you to review all London hotels and pick one whose reviews explicitly mention views of the River Thames, then reserve it for May 28–30, 2024. Once that’s sorted, the Paris arrangements can move ahead.

Thanks,
Mark
